chapter_title: [C]oncerning the Father of Gr[eat]ness: [ho]w he is established and determined.
chapter_note: After a brief hagiographic/dialogue incipit (¶1), the chapter is almost entirely a systematic, impersonal cosmological exposition: the Father of Greatness established in five light limbs (storehouses/qualities) and also in twelve light limbs (wisdoms), then a sequential description of the five. No explicit institutional, exhortational, or NT-overlay material appears in the preserved text; the low teaching-density in ¶8 seems driven by damage/lacunae rather than a register shift.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Dialogue/homiletic frame: "Once again the apostle ... to his disciples" + direct address "Hear this lesson"; this is compilation apparatus rather than the teaching substrate.

paragraphs.core_text: Very great is [land of] light in the presence of they who will hear and know it, due to the first Father of Greatness. How he ex[ists and is] established in his five light limbs, which are [ ... the store]houses that have neither limit nor measure to the[m ... ] mind, thought, insight, counsel and [consideration ... ] his twelve light limbs that are his twelve wisdoms.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic cosmological structuring (five limbs/storehouses + twelve limbs/wisdoms) in an expository voice; both sides of the mapping remain internal to the Light-realm architecture.

paragraphs.core_text: Now, there are five great light lim[bs] in each one [ ... ] five grea[t] springs of praise gush for[th ... ] five great [ ... ] lig[ht ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Iterative numeration and internal cosmic parallelism (five limbs ↔ five springs of praise); no audience-address or institutional anchoring.

paragraphs.core_text: The first is his light that enlig[htens ... ] it gushed forth from him and pour[ed ... ] a[l]] aeons.
paragraphs.temporal_note: First item in a fivefold sequence describing emanative function within the aeons; impersonal, process description typical of the older teaching style.

paragraphs.core_text: The second is the perfume of the [ ... ] and pervades all the aeons of greatness.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second item of the fivefold limbs, expressed as a cosmic quality (perfume) pervading aeons—correspondential register (scent/emanation) stays within the system.

paragraphs.core_text: The third is his living voice of [ ... ... ] all his aeons [ ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third limb as "living voice" (a standard Manichaean cosmological potency) in a purely intra-cosmic description; no frame markers.

paragraphs.core_text: The fourth is his [ ... ]-ness [ ... ] gushes forth from him [ ... o]ut [ ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the enumerated limb-sequence; the verb "gushes forth" sustains the emanation/process register rather than exhortation or polemic.

paragraphs.core_text: ⟨p.65⟩ The fif[th] is his great glorio[us ... ] that [ ... , w]hich [has been ma]nifested all the tim[e], whi[ch contin]ues [ ... ] all of them. It was sculpted in them [ ... ] sealed in the [m ... ] sealed [ ... ] as they send [ ... ] in [ ... ... ] they too receive nourishment [ ... ] immediately [ ... his] living voi[ce ... ] joy [ ... ] set up anew. It shall gush forth from it [ ... ] they shall [ ... ] and become rich in the [ ... ] too is beautiful [ ... ] portray[al ... ] adornment [ ... ] and they live [ ... ... ] for ev[e]r.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Despite heavy lacunae, this reads as the fifth limb’s cosmic effecting/inscribing/sealing and nourishment/renewal within the aeons—no turn toward church practice, commands, or Gospel citation; low register score likely reflects damaged text rather than later overlay.
